segments.contextBefore: **One or more return types.** Use the keys found in [`Item return result keys`](item-return-result-keys.md) to indicate whether you seek the item’s attributes, the item’s data, a reference to the data, a persistent reference to the data, or a combination of these. When you specify more than one return type, the search returns a dictionary containing each of the types you request. When your search allows multiple results, they’re all returned together in an array of items.

`result`: On return, a reference to the found items. The exact type of the result depends on the return type values supplied in `query`, as discussed in [`Item return result keys`](item-return-result-keys.md).
